about: Two lognormal inputs that move together strongly, summed. The sum's spread depends on the correlation, so a wrong Iman-Conover step shows in its percentiles.

files.model.yaml:
dsl: 1
model: tiny
title: Moving together
currency: USD

nodes:

  request_rate:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: request/second
    value: 200
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "the busy hour, as stated for this case"}

  service_demand:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: core*second/request
    value: 0.02
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "processor time per request, as stated for this case"}

  cores:
    kind: input
    decided: you
    unit: core
    value: 16
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "the fleet chosen for this case"}

  busy_cores:
    kind: derived
    unit: core
    formula: request_rate * service_demand

  utilisation:
    kind: derived
    unit: dimensionless
    formula: busy_cores / cores

  first_cost:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: USD
    distribution: {lognormal: {p10: 100.0, p90: 400.0}}
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "lognormal: a price"}

  second_cost:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: USD
    distribution: {lognormal: {p10: 50.0, p90: 900.0}}
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "lognormal: a price"}

  third_cost:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: USD
    distribution: {triangular: {minimum: 10.0, likely: 40.0, maximum: 300.0}}
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "triangular: a quote's range"}

  total_cost:
    kind: derived
    unit: USD
    formula: first_cost + second_cost + third_cost

outputs:
  - utilisation
  - total_cost

correlations:
  - {a: first_cost, b: second_cost, rho: 0.9, because: "the same supplier"}
  - {a: second_cost, b: third_cost, rho: -0.3, because: "stated for this case"}
files.scenarios/more_cores.yaml:
scenario: more_cores
title: Reference
because: the model as declared
samples: 100000
seed: 20260916
overrides:
  cores: 16
